pr_title: systemd-sleep: use resume_offset value if set
pr_body:
When using a `swapfile` for hibernate, use the `resume_offset` value that has been set. If no `resume_offset` value is found, attempt to calculate as before.

Fixes https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/11939

issue_context.title: systemctl hibernate does not hibernate on swapfile on Btrfs after kernel 5.0
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
241.7

**Used distribution**
Archlinux

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
`systemctl hibernate` should hibernate on swap file on Btrfs after kernel 5.0

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
Btrfs supports swapfile after kernel 5.0. `echo disk > /sys/power/state`  works fine to hibernate but `systemctl hibernate` failed.
Since Btrfs is using virtual physical offset of the file. The current logic in sleep.c does not get the correct physical offset of the file. The resume_offset kernel parameter is also ignored and overriden by systemd so it is unable to get the correct offset.

https://github.com/systemd/systemd/blob/c5e6f734c6477d1347a42074b208b4ef71c3095a/src/sleep/sleep.c#L80


**Steps to reproduce the problem**
1. Create swapfile on btrfs according to man 5 btrfs
2. Activate swap file in fstab
3. Calculate the physical offset of swapfile and add kernel parameter
resume=/dev/nvme1n1p2 resume_offset=52761856
4. echo disk > /sys/power/state works fine to hibernate 
5. systemctl hibernate failed.
[   26.828436] PM: Cannot find swap device, try swapon -a
[   26.828441] PM: Cannot get swap writer

review_comments: I like this. The new logic is pretty clear: `resume_offset` is subordinate to `resume` (the device) so we use one or both if `resume` is populated, and calculate the pair ourselves otherwise.
Thanks for all the help getting this into shape, @keszybz and @poettering. I really appreciate your support.

> As a bonus point (this probably should be separate commit), we should refuse to look for the offset using read_fiemap() if the file is on btrfs. We know the result will be wrong.

@keszybz here is my attempt at the bonus point as a separate commit :wink:
